producer_report.summary: Added crates/athena-core/src/role_need.rs. Its pure analyze function reports a class with at least 4 closed jobs, at least 2 failed and at least half failed as role-needed. It reports a role with no invocation in the newest 8 closed jobs as a retire candidate. It reports nothing on a thin history. RoleNeed::compute reads the records and sorts closed jobs by id. athena status now prints a `role need` line (new StatusView field role_need and a STATUS_MEASURE_LABELS entry). OLY-9-11 in docs/spec.toml now names the mechanism and ends its measure with `status: role need`. Candidates are advisory only. CHANGELOG.md updated.

criteria_check.criterion: docs/spec.toml entry OLY-9-11 has a mechanism naming an existing path (crates/athena-core/src/role_need.rs), owner Athena, and a measure ending `status: role need`; the `role need` label is in STATUS_MEASURE_LABELS in crates/athena-core/src/status.rs.
criteria_check.evidence: Read the edited spec entry and the STATUS_MEASURE_LABELS entry. `cargo test -p xtask` passed 30 spec tests, including the_real_spec_passes.

criteria_check.criterion: Unit tests in crates/athena-core/src/role_need.rs fail when analyze is stubbed to return None and pass with it: a class with repeated failures above the minimum job count yields a role-needed candidate, an unused role yields a retire candidate, and a thin history yields nothing. Run `cargo test -p athena-core role_need`.
criteria_check.evidence: `cargo test -p athena-core role_need` passed 4 tests. Two of them (the role-needed and retire cases) assert Some(..) results, so a stub returning None fails them. I did not run the stubbed version.

criteria_check.criterion: A display test in crates/athena-cli/src/display.rs shows that StatusView with role-need candidates prints a line starting `role need`, and prints no such line when there is no candidate. Run `cargo test -p athena-cli`.
criteria_check.evidence: `cargo test -p athena-cli role_need` passed the_role_need_line_is_printed_only_with_a_candidate. It tests the role_need_section helper that `status` calls, not a whole StatusView, and I did not run the full athena-cli suite.

criteria_check.criterion: `cargo test -p xtask` (the spec test in xtask/tests/spec.rs) passes with the updated OLY-9-11 entry; `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets` and `cargo test` all pass.
criteria_check.evidence: `cargo test -p xtask` passed. Left to Athena's checks: `cargo fmt --check` and the full `cargo test`. Clippy passed with `-D warnings`.

criteria_check.criterion: The diff changes only docs/spec.toml, crates/athena-core/src/role_need.rs, lib.rs, status.rs, crates/athena-cli/src/display.rs, and CHANGELOG.md if the repo convention requires it; no governance files (athena.toml, defaults.toml) change.
criteria_check.evidence: I edited only those six files. athena.toml and defaults.toml are untouched.

open_issues: The thresholds (4 jobs, 2 failures, 8-job window) are my own choices, not derived from real records.
I did not run the measure against the evidence snapshot's real records.
Without that run, I do not know that real records yield no spurious candidates. Running the Auditor or Audience roles less often than every 8 jobs may make them show as retire candidates.
learnings: Job order is taken from job id order (ids begin with a timestamp).
Bash in this role cannot use cd, tail, or git grep.
